_comment: MAINNET deployment template for the ShaSwap reference solver (Rev 25 clearing-price-pin set). Copy to deployment.mainnet.json, fill the <...> values from the mainnet deploy (see documentation/launch/mainnet-checklist.md), and confirm the startup banner prints 'network=MAINNET' before setting SHASWAP_SUBMIT=1. The four script hashes (settlement/order/pool/lp_intent) + nft_name / lp_name / total_lp / min_liq / *_min_ada are NETWORK-INDEPENDENT (a script hash does not depend on the network; pool/order/lp_intent are S-applied, S is byte-identical on mainnet) and already match contracts/plutus.json + constants.ak — copy them verbatim. pool_mint_policy is the one identity that is NOT network-independent: see its note below.
_provider: Point at your OWN mainnet node (Kupo + Ogmios, or Dolos) for a no-third-party-dependency setup. Localhost shown; replace with your endpoints.
_pool_mint_policy: PER-POOL, NOT network-independent. Each pool has its own one-shot NFT/LP minting policy = resolveScriptHash(applyParamsToScript(pool_mint compiled code, [the pool's seed OutputReference])); f558dfb2… is only the UNAPPLIED template and never appears on-chain. Set this to the applied policy id of the specific pool this batcher serves (the batcher discovers pools by pool_mint_policy + nft_name), once that pool is created on mainnet. On preprod the canonical pool's policy is d5ccd174… (see contracts/happy_path/deployment.json).
_refs: The CANONICAL, immutable mainnet reference scripts (settlement #0, pool #1, order #2, lp_intent #3) from the 2026-06-08 deploy tx d56e729c… (block 13,526,295) — the same for every operator, re-hashed on-chain against the audited Rev 25 hashes. lp_intent_ref is REQUIRED for the batcher to fulfil LP intents (Rev 22); omit it only to run settlements-only.
_skey: cardano-cli TextEnvelope signing key for the solver wallet. File mode 0600, OUTSIDE the repo. Controls only the solver's own float, never user funds.
